description:
Store one agent execution (input, output, tool calls, spans, cost, tokens) and get the trace_id later calls key on.

What it does. Writes one immutable trace to local storage; nothing is deduplicated. Only agent_name is required; store tool_calls, tools, cost and input/output so the rules can judge them. evaluate: true (with output) also scores it in this call, exactly as evaluate_output would. Full detail: iris://capabilities.

When not to use it. To score a stored trace (evaluate_output with its trace_id). To change one (delete_trace, then log again).

Returns. JSON: trace_id, status, evaluation.

Errors. IRIS_STORAGE_ERROR; IRIS_INVALID_ARGUMENT when evaluate is true without output. Unknown or malformed arguments are refused, naming the valid keys. Failures return {"error":{code,message,recovery}} with isError; follow recovery.

Siblings. evaluate_output — score the stored output; get_traces — query what was logged; delete_trace — remove one trace.

agent_name.description: Agent name — used for filtering in get_traces (e.g., "customer-support-bot")

case_key.description: What makes this the same question across runs (a fixture or test id); pairs traces. Derived from input when omitted

cost_usd.description: Total cost in USD — overrides per-span aggregation when provided (treated as authoritative)

eval_type.description: With evaluate: true, the bundle to run (default: every bundle, noted in the response)

evaluate.description: Also score the stored trace in this call, exactly as evaluate_output would; requires output

framework.description: Agent framework identifier (e.g., langchain, autogen, custom)

input.description: Agent input text — the user prompt or upstream input that produced this output

latency_ms.description: Total execution time in milliseconds (end-to-end agent latency)

metadata.description: Opaque key-value tags (e.g. {requestId, userId, env}) — queryable in dashboard, not via get_traces filters

output.description: Agent output text — what the agent produced (pass to evaluate_output for scoring)

run.description: The batch this execution belongs to (a CI job id, a sweep); compare_runs compares two runs

session_id.description: The conversation this turn belongs to; groups its turns. Read from SEP-414 baggage when omitted

spans.description: Detailed execution spans (hierarchical span tree with timings, attributes, events); a span without start_time takes the trace timestamp

timestamp.description: Trace timestamp (ISO 8601); defaults to now() when omitted

token_usage.description: Token usage breakdown (prompt/completion/total — used for cost analysis)

tool_calls.description: Tool calls made, in order, each { tool_name, input?, output?, latency_ms?, error? }; the trajectory rules judge them

tools.description: Your MCP tools/list result, verbatim; lets the rules check call arguments later

name: log_trace
title: Log Trace
